object_description: longitudinal building paired with a tall disk-like tower
design_condition: The longitudinal building and tower form a sequence of scales and open spaces along the station side of Zürcherstrasse, with the open hall serving the transport hub.

positive.statement: The urban-planning arrangement is positive and creates an exciting series with its varied scales.
The cubic reduction gives the heterogeneous context a calming effect.
The longitudinal structure creates a new center in a harmonious way.
The open ground-floor hall takes on the functions of the public transport hub.
Splitting the program into two buildings is strategically clever because they offer different qualities.
The column grid allows the open office floor to be used freely and flexibly.
The apartments have partly double-storey airspaces and a consistent vision of the Reuss loop.

negative.statement: The project lacks meaningful development of the open-space and traffic aspects.
The pedestrian ramp system, a key element of the transport hub, is missing.
The underground-car-park dimensions are too small.
The exit toward Zürcherstrasse is likely to create potential for conflict.
The traffic hub and separate platform roof feel hard and insufficiently harmonious.
The green open space with bicycle shelters was not developed.
The arcade's attractiveness is questionable because access conditions are cramped.
The tower's closed appearance toward Zürcherstrasse is not adequate.
The serial building structures create a somewhat harsh industrial expression without sufficient public appeal.
